summary: David DiNardo explains how a year of solo podcast episodes he found too cringeworthy to watch back turned into a client who signed up for bookkeeping, accounting and tax in under 15 minutes. The prospect had compared three competitors, but chose David because he had already watched his reels and felt he knew him before the call. The episode argues that organic content is a five-to-ten-year play that builds relationships and distribution no paid ad campaign can match.
takeaways: A client found David through one of his reels, reviewed three competitors, and still signed with him in under 15 minutes because the relationship was already built through his content.
It took roughly a year and 50 solo episodes before David could watch one of his own videos all the way through without cringing.
Treat social media as a five-year minimum play, ten if you want to be super successful; David has committed to Taxifi for at least ten years before deciding anything.
Do one simple thing every day for ten years and you will master it and people will come to you for that value.
Organic content puts you in front of the public and removes the initial layers of a sales conversation, whereas Meta Ads could take six months and thousands of dollars to reach a conversion.
Never let fear eliminate you from opportunity; the people who put themselves out there out-compete smarter, more technical rivals whose fear holds them back.
Whoever owns distribution owns the moat, so build an audience while you build the business.
